name: spine (lumbar) extension
description: Gently arching the lower back backward, working the muscles along the spine.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Lean back gently, arching your lower back within a comfortable range.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
